description: A C# game engine in which a program opens a window, draws each frame with plain static calls named as raylib's functions are, and draws Dear ImGui in the same frame, over SDL3, Vulkan and Slang, with an ECS and source-generated behaviors underneath.
releaseNotes:
A hit's march to a glow light takes the width across its way of the faces that emit toward it where not every face emits, so the floor in the shadow of a ledge under a lamp set flush in a wall takes none of the lamp past the ledge's edge and the ledge's front reads nearer the reference.
A mesh of the ray scene no copy has placed for sixty frames gives its structure back and its corners are dropped, the builds share one scratch grown in steps, the switch and the state say what the probes' rays are traced through, and a pushed commit whose sentence lacks its full stop goes on its rule's list.
A hit's march to a glow light sets out half a cell off its surface, and the test of the lamp in the wall reads the ledge's front apart from the wall above it
A surface the screen's march meets past a stretch the ray spent behind the depth hands the ray to the field, so a ray into a ledge whose top the eye sees edge on meets the top and not the floor in its shadow.
A hit's march to a glow light aims at the middle of the emitting face it faces most squarely where not every face emits, so a lamp set flush in a wall lights its own wall through the room as the reference does.
A compile where no runtime folder stands makes its folder in the user's own cache, whatever folder a test set as the engine's cache and deletes as it ends.
A program's own shader is looked up once a draw as the frame's batches are gathered, and the passes that draw it read what the batch carries.
The readings carry the pictures of the work since the ninth of November, the occlusion sheet, the scene's fetch, the far room and the glow lights' buried faces against the reference among them, each as WebP with its caption.
The shader compiler is taken from the nearest checkout of the engine alone and only where the user owns it, and a compile writes in a folder of its own closed to others.
The glow lights' loop over a box's axes is unrolled, taking back what checking each face put on the model pass.
The circular occluders' raw and filtered images are cleared to open each frame before their passes write, so a texel of the sky reads the same in every drawing.
The circular occluders at eight points a pixel are a build the shipped cache holds, their images and sets go once the method is switched away, a slope compensation or a radius they cannot take is held or refused, and the far room's test says what each stage read.
A computed state or a sub state is entered at the transition point that brings it in, its machine applied after the one it is worked out from, whichever was made first.
The window's ambient occlusion can be worked out by circular occluders, CORTAO's three passes, beside the horizons, which stay the default.
A quality of global illumination that names no value is refused with an error naming it, the quality kept as it was, and a scene pack's documentation says what its manifest holds.
title: 3DEngine
